verdict.rationale: A banking platform with a dashboard could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains no in-product AI insights or suggestions. Automatic reconciliation via unique Account Numbers, Entity validations and llms.txt/OpenAPI availability are rule-based or developer-facing features, not AI-generated insights from user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
